steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Um... Hello, Yato, ma'am.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Hello.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hold on, you... you know me?

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Y-Yes. I've studied Team A4's combat reports...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Oh. And you are?

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: I'm Mandy, ma'am.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I haven't seen you around before... a new recruit?

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Yes! I arrived in March, passed the field operator assessments, and am currently enrolled in the Guard Operator course!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: A Guard Operator... Do you know how to wield a blade?

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: I learned a little, but why do you ask—

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Take this.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: This blade... It's the one you always carry.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Wield it, and let's have a match to see how strong you are.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Whoa?! I—How could I? I'm definitely nowhere near the level to spar with you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No need to belittle yourself. Use all your strength, and I'll make my own judgement.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Yato, wait!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Old man Rangers. Since you're here, help me observe—

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Enough teasing the kid. They have classes soon.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Fine... I'm sorry.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: It's alright. Then, I'll be...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Yes, yes. Go do your own thing.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I have to say, Yato, I keep seeing you on the hunt for rookies recently. You should really give these youngsters a break. They wouldn't even last two moves against you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That so? I don't remember being that weak when I first came to Rhodes Island... Or at least, I could spar with the veterans for more than two moves.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: That was a long time ago. We didn't have as many people as we do now, and we all started working as soon as we arrived.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Times have changed. Now it's popular to train the newcomers, consolidate their fundamentals, and then, how do you put it... Oh, yes. Help them integrate into their work environment.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: They even have a three-legged skating competition these days. It's enough to make an old man jealous.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I see. Apparently I haven't kept myself informed on our training policies.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: It's not really something you need to be informed about. Care for a can of soda?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Catches can)

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Then again, passing the operator assessment exam is no walk in the park, even now. All they lack is combat experience, so they'll catch up in no time.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So, anyone among them with notable combat skills?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Hmm... Can't say I've kept up with that myself. Though I can help you ask around. But why?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...You know that my blade is broken.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Oh, yes. I remember now, you were chopping metal crabs left and right. You even asked Noir Corne for a spare.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Perhaps you can pay Logistics another visit for a replacement, or look for Vulcan to make you a new custom weapon. I'm sure she'd be happy to help.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Or could it be that... you're looking for a disciple to pass your old blade on to, as a token?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Hahaha, don't mind this old man and his jests—

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Ha... ha... that can't be it, right...?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I did have something like that in mind.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: But, Yato... that makes no sense.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I know... I'm not an instructor, and I wouldn't know how to teach anyone anyway. Besides, would they ever have need of it?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Forget it, it's nothing. I'll need to think about this more.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Yato... Now this is a rare sight.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: So this blade of yours... considering its age and the number of past repairs, it's impossible to restore it to a usable state.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: After applying for equipment scrapping, you have two choices: apply for a standard new blade from Logistics, or contact me for a custom make if you have any special requirements. You just have to fill out the right form.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: But it seems to me this blade means something special to you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's the first blade I received after arriving on Rhodes Island. It was smelted with fragments of my blade from my Higashi days.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: So it's been reforged before... I see, so that's why it's somewhat weak.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It was already broken when it was passed down to me from my swordplay teacher, before it became this.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's a little strange, but I've been away from my homeland for so long, and yet even now I still recall its history when I look at this... That's what made me want to keep it.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: That's unfortunate. So that's why you're at such a loss as to what to do with it.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Alright, I respect your traditions, but I have to say that realizing your wish will be difficult, at least in the short term. Accepting a disciple to pass down your blade won't be a simple affair.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Besides, it isn't really usable anymore, so I doubt anyone on Rhodes Island would want it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: To be honest, I never thought this day would come. I thought it would outlive me, or at worst break in battle.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But you're right... I should just give up on this.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Hmm... If you still want to use it, I do have a method we can try, although it's an old technique.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You could have the blade reforged anew, but it'll become even weaker and more brittle. I wouldn't recommend it for high intensity combat.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: It's up to you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Understood... I'll need to think it over.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Got distracted again...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You... Why is this one blade making you so uneasy, Yato?
Sorry to disturb you, Yato, ma'am.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...You were looking for me?
Yes.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And you are?
I'm Celine, Celine Freeman. I'm currently interning at Field Operations, and aiming to become a Vanguard Operator.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And what business do you have with me?

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Breathes deeply)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Sorry, I overheard your conversation with Rangers earlier. That you're looking for someone to spar with. So... I'd like to have a match with you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You want to spar with me?

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Um, yes... I want to win the right to learn from you.

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: Celine... She actually went to find Yato!

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Surely she hasn't forgotten what happened when she went looking for Flamebringer? She's been acting so strange ever since she failed the exam in swordsmanship class.

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: She might as well have 'I must prove myself' written on her face, seeing how stubborn she is. I hear Yato's pretty blunt though, so she probably wouldn't agree to—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Sure.

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: I'll make sure not to go overboard...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No need.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Alright then... here I come!

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (She, she dodged?)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Behind.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (She's so fast, but I can keep up...)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Aha!

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: Did you catch that?

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Uh... No.

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: When did Yato's blade... end up at Celine's throat?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You lose.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Ma'am, I... I want another try!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Come.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (That move didn't work earlier, so maybe this one will...)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Heh!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hmm... You lose. Again.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (How can this be? I definitely dodged her attack, so she should have missed me!)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (But this blade... is right here again...)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Let's call it a day.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: No, wait... Yato, please let me try again! One last time!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You're no match for me.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: I... I won't lose this time!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Then come at me.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (I know how she fights, so if I move like Flamebringer did back then, I'll definitely...)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Hup—!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hmm?

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: I... lost again.

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: The disparity... is huge.

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: Even her sword was knocked away. Yato really is ruthless.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You dropped your blade.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You... should practice more diligently with your instructors.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Hmf... *snore*...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I lose.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Judging from the situation on the table, it seems our winner is...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Three times in a row? Your luck's pretty good today.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Did you switch to a new mask today, Noir Corne?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, I broke the previous one in battle, remember? So I sent it in for repairs—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait, no! It's not like I switched out my mask to change my luck! I wouldn't do anything like that!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yes, yes. Same rules as always: whoever loses treats the others. And I lost. So what does everyone want?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Dry martini as usual.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Durin... never mind. I'll get her a glass of fresh pressed juice.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Then, I also want a glass of—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: One dry martini, one fresh pressed juice, and two Waters of Life mixed with vanilla soda, thank you.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Noir Corne? Didn't you yell 'I won't drink another drop of cactus juice, I need a Water of Life with vanilla soda before I die!' while being chased by metal crabs, so why—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What are you guys talking about? Water of Life with vanilla soda, right? I already ordered one for you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hah. Okay.

steps.name: Durin
steps.text: Phew... Strange, Yato's drinking too.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Yato. Are you still worrying about your blade?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It's fine.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I heard you sparred with a kid in the Training Room today. How was she?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So-so. Good fundamentals, but too hasty with offense. And lacking experience to boot.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: *Sigh* I look away for just a moment and Yato gets into another fight.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I asked around after I got back. The youngster's called... uh... Celine, I believe. She's actually considered one of the best among her peers.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: So if she didn't impress, the rest won't either. I suppose passing down your blade won't be easy.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Oh, Celine. I know her. I've brought her along to simulation training once or twice.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What did you think of her?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: About the same as you, she's too hasty. She trains real hard and has a good head on her, but her performance in actual combat is all wack.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: She's introverted, hates admitting defeat, bad at asking for advice, and always stubbornly insists on running out on her own.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: There's something special about her. During our sparring matches, one of her moves resembled one that Flamebringer guy uses. I heard later that she's also sparred with him.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, she's a kid whose strengths and weaknesses are both obvious, and every instructor she's had has told her the same.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: *sigh* She knows it herself, but her self-esteem takes a hit every time she meets a setback, which just makes her even more anxious and prevents her from moving forward.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What a shame...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Don't you think she resembles you from back then, Yato?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, not at all.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Sorry to interrupt, but there's something I've been wondering. Besides the tradition of passing down your blade to a disciple, is there any other reason you want to do this?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Other reason? Why do you ask?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Haha, forgive an old man's ramblings, but we're all employees here, and the youngsters are our colleagues receiving professional training. So there's no particular need to do this sort of thing.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Vulcan said something similar. I thought it over, and there really isn't a reason to. I'd even prefer it if this blade weren't needed at all...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I did something else this morning. I went to HR to request more manpower, and was told that the rookies aren't up to standards yet, and can't join our Reserve Op Team.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So what we discussed before, about getting more people, won't be happening. Most likely we'll have to handle all the work ourselves for the time being.

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: That's how we've always done things, so I have no complaints. I'm sure the others feel the same.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I know, but...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne, how many stitches did you get from this last mission?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Five... no, six...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: And the old injury on your shoulder flared up three times, old timer. Think I didn't know?

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: It's true.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Durin has lost several sleeping bags too. Even though our missions have only gotten more arduous, I'm sure we can manage. But for how long?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That's why I've been thinking about this blade. If we can find a suitable sprout to help with our work, then it won't be a complete waste of time.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Or to put it another way, even if we're no longer here someday, this blade at least can remain...

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Yato...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, we completed the mission and actually managed to gather everyone for drinks for once, so why all the long faces?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: There's booze, so drink up! All of us, together!

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: Hear, hear! Let us drink.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Cheers.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Uh... Sorry to spoil your fun, but I'm looking for Yato...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You're... the intern Operator from this morning.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Mandy!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Ah, yes. You. I remember.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Umm...

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: What are you so afraid of? Just say it!

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: So the thing is! I saw you and Celine sparring this morning! I... even though my current combat skills are far from adequate, I really want to learn from you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Learn? From me?

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Yes! I'm really interested in the way you fight...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Sorry, but to be frank, I'm not even sure I know how to teach others. I don't have any experience in this area.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, I've got a great idea!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yato, want to join me at my simulation training session tomorrow? We can go a round as a demonstration for the kids! I'm used to it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Simulation training. So you mean... we just fight in front of them?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Yeah, I do this all the time.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So whenever I couldn't find you, it was because you were busy with simulation training?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah, hehe...

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Ah... That would be wonderful!

steps.name: Rangers
steps.text: I agree. It would also let you experience what it's like to teach.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What do you think? Come on, Yato, consider it!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Fine, let's give it a try.

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: Shh. No talking, everyone. Noir Corne is speaking.

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Mandy! Over here!

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Coming, coming.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: *ahem* Someone wasn't listening, so I'll repeat.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Our special guest for today's simulation training is Yato, my team leader.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Mhm.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Next up, I'll spar with her and demonstrate Op Team A4's combat style.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Alright, Yato. Let's go.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Noir Corne and Yato... I thought they were just going to act it out for us, but they're really fighting for real!

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Can you handle it, Noir Corne?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ha, ha, here I come!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey!

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Noir Corne went all out with that. If it were me, I would try and dodge the strike, but Yato...)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Whispering) Do you want to slow it down, so they can see it clearer?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: (Whispering) Stay focused. And don't underestimate me, yeah?

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (He blocked it head-on... Could it be that he intended to stop the opponent's attack trajectory?)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (They've distanced themselves again.)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hah. I'm going to be serious now.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Take this!

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Yato has a methodical fighting style, so I should be able to predict...)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Whoops, I lose.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (In that last move, Yato dodged Noir Corne's attack, and flanked him with just footwork.)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (She probably used the same method when she appeared behind me in our match...)

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: That was a simple encounter and confrontation, everyone. You guys catch that? You can watch the replay in the terminal if you didn't.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Alright, I'll be your opponent for the rest of this simulation training session— Huh, Yato?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll do it.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wha?!

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: Huh?!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll be everyone's opponent for the rest of today's session.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Wait, Yato—

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is there a problem?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: No, but simulation training comes with some rules.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Such as?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: A reward. We always have some kind of reward here. So what kind of prize are you going to offer?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Just one hit.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If anyone can land a single hit on me, I'll teach them everything I know about combat, full stop.

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: Wow...

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Me! Yato, I'll do it!
Several hours later...

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: *sigh* I couldn't even last two moves.

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Why are you sighing? Look at the others, two moves against her is plenty.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: I already challenged her three times. I've watched so many records, but I still don't understand her fighting style...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Anyone else?

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Where's Celine? Has she actually not had a go yet?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If there's no one else, then let's call it here for today.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: I want to try.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (Tosses blade)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Come.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Phew...

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (She's still making the same moves flawlessly, and I can't tell which angle she'll attack from.)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Better get ready... and wait for her to strike.)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So I take it you're letting me go first?

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (I-I barely made it.)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Focus everything into the blade, and confront it head-on... this method does seem to work.)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Very good.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (I-Is she talking to me?)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll keep going.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: *cough*

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Dodged it... but there's a chance!)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (She got out of the way, she's way too fast...)

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Celine and Yato have already exchanged three moves? You're not kidding?

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: She even retaliated once...

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Shh, quiet! Look carefully. The way Celine's dodging is pretty similar to how Yato moved earlier.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: She's not only adapting to her fighting rhythm, but actually learning it too...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Slow down.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Is she... giving me advice?)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Alright, I managed to block the last few attacks.)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (I think I've got her attack rhythm down, so I'm sure I can... manage a counterattack.)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (It's time to try moving like she does.)

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: (Move out of the way, and then immediately strike with the blade just like she did—)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Heh.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Celine, she... landed a hit on Yato?!

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: No way?! Celine! You did it!

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: I! I did it? I did hit something, but...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You lose.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: What is... this floating down...?

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: A piece of cloth?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You have to switch between focusing on your blade or your opponent depending on the situation. You're still too hasty.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: ...Thank you.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But you did learn. I'm glad.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: I... No, I didn't...

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Awesome! Celine! Great job out there!

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Celine, you're amazing!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (It's rare to learn this much in such a short span of time... Celine... perhaps she makes the cut...)

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: That was crazy. Now I gotta work hard to reach Celine's level.

steps.name: Intern Operator C
steps.text: Yeah, I hope we can keep sparring with Yato...
Yato almost offers the blade once more, but her hand rests on the hilt as she looks at the Operators around her.
She sees several pairs of young eyes, all laser-focused on her.
She suddenly realizes it is she herself reflected in them.

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: Yato!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Is there something else?

steps.name: Celine
steps.text: I... Even though I lost, can... can I still fight you again next time? I really learned a lot from sparring with you.

steps.name: Intern Operator A
steps.text: Me too!

steps.name: Intern Operator B
steps.text: We want to continue practicing with you, Yato.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Listen up. I'll be here tomorrow and do some simulation training with everyone. Corne, there shouldn't be any problems with that, right?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Shouldn't be more than filling in an application form. I'll take care of it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll also bring a blade and leave it in the Training Room.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Since no one could beat me today, I've decided...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: From today onwards, as long as I'm here, anyone can pick up that blade to spar with me. I'll always be happy to oblige.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I look forward to seeing you next time, Rhodes Island newcomers.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: So, you had a few rounds with those youths, then decided to smelt this blade away?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: You could put it that way.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: You're planning to give your blade to one of the kids you've got your sights on? Wait, no... you wouldn't need to smelt it down for that.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Mhm. This blade will still face combat.

steps.name: Vulcan
steps.text: Then I'll get the furnace burning, but remember what I told you...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Of course. 'Don't use it in high intensity combat.'

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: From now on it'll be left here at base, and only used for one battle, wielded by different hands.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Until a distant future, when... perhaps a day when we are no longer here.
She watches the blade sink slowly into the forge, its structure as brilliant as the blazing sun, and gradually melt.
Finally, its shape is gone completely, leaving only a ball of red liquid.
Like fresh blood.
